text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"organized into claim and examples","quality":"organization","description":"The essay groups ideas into a clear response with an introduction, support, and conclusion rather than listing thoughts in a long run-on sequence."},{"evidence":"\"When a problem is present...\" repeated as support","quality":"development","description":"The essay develops its point with repeated elaboration and multiple explanatory examples instead of brief unsupported preferences."},{"evidence":"\"For example...\" and \"For another example...\"","quality":"use of examples","description":"The essay uses relevant examples to illustrate its idea and connect it to the prompt."},{"evidence":"\"what is it that is making the problem, what it is affecting, and whom is it affecting\"","quality":"sentence control","description":"The essay shows better control of sentence boundaries and clause structure, even though it still has errors."},{"evidence":"\"new things and methods to solve it\"","quality":"word choice","description":"The essay uses more precise academic and problem-solving vocabulary than the more informal phrasing in the other essay."}]}
